name: Screen Craft Advertising LLC Dubai
headline: #1 Exhibition Stand Builders & Contractors
lede: Professional exhibition stand builders and contractors Dubai. Custom stand design, fabrication, and installation for trade shows and events.
about: We offer a complete solution — from custom stand design and 3D visualization to fabrication, transport, installation, and dismantling after the event. Our goal is to deliver a hassle-free, turnkey experience.
Depending on the complexity and size, it typically takes 2–4 weeks from design approval to final delivery. We also offer express solutions for tight deadlines.
